title: Embedded Linux, Specialized Systems, and Legacy Environments
learning_outcomes: Recognize the constraints of embedded, minimal, legacy, real-time, ARM, and research Linux deployments.
Apply the module concepts to a safe example and verify the observed result.
Identify at least one distribution/version difference or operational safety concern.
